description:
FILED s513i (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-10), pre-existing (identical on main e0b61a99), stderr only.

A `require` of an XS module that PCL cannot load, TRAPPED by an eval, still prints SBCL's load-context lines on stderr:

    eval { require I18N::Langinfo; 1 } or print "no\n";
    print "x\n";
    perl: no / x (stderr empty)
    PCL:  no / x, and on stderr:
          While evaluating the form starting at line 160, column 0
            of #P"/tmp/pcl-nocache-XXXX.lisp":

The die is caught (the program goes on correctly); the two lines are SBCL's "While evaluating the form" context, written when the module's load is unwound.  Every program that probes an optional XS module this way shows them (ExtUtils::MakeMaker::Locale's _init probes I18N::Langinfo, so `use ExtUtils::MakeMaker` does, and with the Encode shim it now loads -- s513i).  Probe: scratch/s513i/m/u4.pl (worktree agent-abee999f28ae9ef84).
subject: A TRAPPED require of an unloadable XS module (`eval { require I18N::Langinfo }`) still prints SBCL "While evaluating the form" context lines on stderr
